observations: Multiple retail boxes for Sony PlayStation 5 consoles are shown.
The console illustration on the boxes features the horizontal slit characteristic of the 'Slim' model.
The boxes depict the version with an integrated disc drive.
The back of one box shows a PEGI 7 rating, which is used in European markets.
The boxes appear to be in a retail or warehouse setting.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GIFTHUB' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The boxes are shown, but the factory seals are not visible to confirm they are unopened.
Authenticity cannot be verified from a single photo of the packaging.
The box art in photo 0 shows the console with a disc drive.
The 'Slim' model shown on the box is the version that comes with 1TB of storage.
A PEGI rating on one box supports a European origin, but the region for all units cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: The console may be used or a refurbished unit inside a new box.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the intact factory seals on the box flaps.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or software-locked (banned).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and connecting to the PlayStation Network.

risks.risk: The box might not contain the advertised model or accessories.
risks.proof: A photo of the console and controller outside of the box.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the factory seals on the box openings.
A photo of the model number and serial number on the bottom of the box.
A video of the console functioning and connected to a TV.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Sony PlayStation 5 (Slim Disc Edition) from the packaging. It is priced at the worst-case scenario of a used, non-functional unit until further proof is provided.
